subject: round g3 (after face_shadow_smaller x2), face_g3.png
reference_style: Monster Hunter Stories 3 (MHS3) anime toon style, male protagonist

jaw_and_chin.reference: in 3/4 the jawline is a long straight diagonal from below the ear to a small, slightly squared chin; the chin is narrow
jaw_and_chin.ours: in 3/4 the jawline is a gently curved line from below the ear to a smaller rounded chin; in front the chin is a narrower V-to-U shape

chin_width.reference: the chin, just above its tip, is about 0.25 of the face width at eye level (measured in the 3/4 frame)
chin_width.ours: the chin, just above its tip, is about 0.35 of the face width at eye level (measured in front)

face_shadow.reference: the front of the face is fully lit; on the far side a narrow shadow band runs along the cheek edge from the temple to the jaw (the skull is hidden under hair)
face_shadow.ours: in front a narrow shadow band runs along the far cheek edge from the temple to the jaw; in 3/4 the shadow covers the far cheek and temple, about a fifth of the face, with a stepped edge (skull ignored: hidden by hair in the reference)

outline.reference: a clear dark-brown outline around the face and jaw, about as thick as the upper lid line
outline.ours: a thin light-brown outline around the face and jaw, thinner than the upper lid line

skin_colour.reference: warm peach skin with warm orange-brown shadow
skin_colour.ours: warm peach skin with warm orange-brown shadow

nose_profile.reference: in 3/4 a straight nose bridge ending in a small pointed tip
nose_profile.ours: in 3/4 a straight nose bridge ending in a small pointed tip
